#compdef jet
# zsh completion for jet (generated by `jet completions zsh`)
_jet() {
local -a commands flags
commands=(
        'run:build, then run a program (or a project)'
        'check:look for problems, build nothing'
        'test:compile and run top-level test blocks'
        'build:compile to a native binary in ./build/'
        'dev:watch a file and re-run it on every save'
        'devtools:run checked developer generators (grammars)'
        'serve:watch a resident program and hot-swap type-stable edits'
        'debug:step through a program at the Jet source level (D-DBG3)'
        'repl:interactive REPL — try Jet expressions without a file'
        'new:create a new project folder'
        'fmt:rewrite a file to canonical style'
        'fix:apply all auto-fixable diagnostics in place'
        'lint:opt-in lint categories, never blocking (--a11y\: D-A11YGATE1)'
        'explain:print the offline essay for a diagnostic code'
        'doctor:diagnose the toolchain and offer fixes'
        'env:enter the project dev shell'
        'push:deploy a fleet through Jetpack'
        'trust:list, explain, grant, and revoke Jet trust authority (D-JPK-GRANTCMD1)'
        'bridge:translate a foreign environment description into Jetpack form'
        'services:manage project-local dev services'
        'image:build a declared OCI image'
        'os:check, build, switch, rollback, list, lift, init, or image a jetos host'
        'bind:generate a C binding cache from a header'
        'add:add a dependency and fetch it'
        'remove:remove a dependency'
        'fetch:download and link all dependencies'
        'update:refresh moving dependency selectors (`update jet` moves the toolchain pin)'
        'toolchain:show the project'\''s pinned jet toolchain and its locked version (D-JPK-TOOLCHAIN1)'
        'init:create a pkg.jet here, pinning the running jet'\''s channel (add <script.jet> to lift its inline deps)'
        'lock:resolve a manifest-less script'\''s inline `use pkg#version;` deps and write its .lock sidecar (D-JPK-SCRIPTDEP1)'
        'store:inspect or verify the package store'
        'config:manage jet configuration (`config trust add/list/remove`, U19)'
        'gc:remove unreferenced store entries'
        'outdated:report Jetpack channel refs with newer locks available'
        'search:search the local offline Jetpack package index'
        'info:show local offline Jetpack package metadata'
        'logs:show latest Jetpack build logs'
        'clean:optimize and collect stale Jetpack hangar entries'
        'publish:publish the current package to the registry'
        'yank:mark a published version as yanked (D-VERSION1)'
        'keygen:create the Ed25519 key that signs published packages (D-PKGSIGN1)'
        'key:manage the package signing key (key backup)'
        'schema:inspect or re-baseline @PublishedSchema snapshots (status | squash)'
        'semindex:query the stable semantic index for a project entry file'
        'dossier:explain a file or symbol through stable semantic fact lenses'
        'impact:report blast radius for a symbol (callers, references, callees)'
        'graph:print typed programmable-build graph (D-BUILDQUERY1)'
        'query:query typed facts; `jet query build <file>` inspects build graph'
        'explain-build:explain one build target, action, or file (D-BUILDQUERY1)'
        'codemod:dry-run, apply, or undo replayable semantic codemods'
        'expand:print sema'\''s facts for one lens (--facts <lens>) or every lens (D-EXPANDCLI1)'
        'vendor:copy all dependencies into vendor/'
        'audit:check dependencies against the advisory database'
        'sbom:emit a software bill of materials from the lockfile'
        'emit:emit generated output (--rust\: print Rust source)'
        'eval:evaluate a pure Jet program to stable JSON (--pure required)'
        'bench:benchmark a Jet program with honest stats'
        'completions:print shell completions (bash | zsh | fish)'
        'man:print the jet man page (roff)'
        'lsp:language server (stdio JSON-RPC)'
        'version:print compiler version'
        'upgrade:how to download a newer release'
        'help:print the help text'
    )
flags=(
        '--json[emit machine-readable diagnostics]'
        '--color[color\: auto | always | never]'
        '--version[print compiler version]'
        '--emit-rust[also print the generated Rust code]'
        '--check[with fmt\: exit 1 if the file would change]'
        '--small[with build/run\: smallest binary (S15)]'
        '--locked[with fetch\: verify only, refuse network]'
        '--annotated[with new\: include commented example deps]'
        '--force[with publish\: bypass pre-publish gate (with warning)]'
        '--message[with yank\: human-readable reason for yanking the version]'
        '--before[with schema squash\: re-baseline migrations before this version]'
        '--spdx[with sbom\: emit SPDX tag-value format (default)]'
        '--cyclonedx[with sbom\: emit CycloneDX JSON format]'
        '--advisory-db[with audit\: path to advisory database file]'
        '--vendor-dir[with vendor\: directory to copy dependencies into (default vendor/)]'
        '--sbom[with build\: also write an SPDX SBOM next to the binary]'
        '--verbose[with build\: print the bridge steps]'
        '--online[with doctor\: allow network checks]'
        '--fix[with doctor\: apply auto-fixable problems]'
        '--dry-run[with fix\: show changes without writing]'
        '--try-anyway[with dev\: interpret past unsupported features (no guarantees)]'
        '--restart[with dev/serve\: always rerun from scratch on save (c77)]'
        '--swap[with dev/serve\: hot-swap type-stable edits, restart on type change (c77)]'
        '--watch[with dev/serve\: --watch=off runs once and exits (c77)]'
        '--project[with repl\: load pkg.jet from this directory for import context (D-REPL10)]'
        '--pure[with eval\: require the program to be pure (S60 / D-PURE2)]'
        '--freestanding[with build/run\: no OS; rejects std-only APIs (E2-M15)]'
        '--allow-impure[with build/run\: allow Tier-2 ambient comptime effects inside #Impure gates (D-CTEFFECT1)]'
        '--allow-exec[with build\: grant declared Exec actions for this run (D-BUILDFLAGS1)]'
        '--allow-fs[with build\: grant declared Fs actions for this run (D-BUILDFLAGS1)]'
        '--allow-net[with build\: grant declared Net actions for this run (D-BUILDFLAGS1)]'
        '--allow-env[with build\: grant declared Env actions for this run (D-BUILDFLAGS1)]'
        '--allow-io[with build\: grant declared Io actions for this run (D-BUILDFLAGS1)]'
        '--allow-db[with build\: grant declared Db actions for this run (D-BUILDFLAGS1)]'
        '--allow-time[with build\: grant declared Time actions for this run (D-BUILDFLAGS1)]'
        '--allow-rand[with build\: grant declared Rand actions for this run (D-BUILDFLAGS1)]'
        '--allow-log[with build\: grant declared Log actions for this run (D-BUILDFLAGS1)]'
        '--allow-gpu[with build\: grant declared Gpu actions for this run (D-BUILDFLAGS1)]'
        '--target[with build\: cross-compile for a rustc target triple (E2-M15)]'
        '--explain-partition[with build --target=web\: print the JS/WASM partition report (D-WASM1)]'
        '--capabilities-json[with build\: emit capability summary as JSON (D-TOOL5)]'
        '--update-snapshots[with test\: update snapshot golden files (D-TOOL4)]'
        '--coverage[with test\: report per-function / per-line coverage (D-COV1)]'
        '--rust[with emit\: print the generated Rust source (D-TOOL3)]'
        '-u[short form of --update-snapshots]'
        '--release[with build/run\: use the release profile (D-BUILDPROFILE1)]'
        '--profile[with build/run\: named build profile --profile=<name> (D-BUILDPROFILE1)]'
        '--a11y[with lint\: check accessibility — missing roles, unlabeled controls (D-A11YGATE1)]'
        '--scope[with trust grant\: grant scope, user or repo (D-JPK-GRANTCMD1)]'
    )
if (( CURRENT == 2 )); then
_describe -t commands 'command' commands
else
_values 'flag' $flags
_files
fi
}
_jet "$@"
